B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist baseline: predict non-barrier for every endpoint at every rung. Reference for the secondary denylist log-loss improvement (DENYLIST_SKILL, reported, non-gating).

B_EXCHANGE.comparison: STATIONARITY_SKILL at each of delta_ref and delta_ext is tested against B_EXCHANGE. The denylist decision is compared with B_CONSTANT_USABLE. B_MARGINAL and B_LASTSWEEP are reported diagnostics only.
B_EXCHANGE.description: Mandated memory/constant null: a GLOBAL uniform permutation of the lag barrier indicator across all 57 endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38900926593), preserving both marginals, recomputing I(B_T0; B_delta) each time. The null that the anchor state carries no information about the lag state beyond its marginal (exchangeable / constant-marginal endpoints).

B_LASTSWEEP.description: Predict the next rung's barrier indicator from the immediately preceding rung rather than from the anchor.

B_MARGINAL.description: Predict the lag class from the lag-period marginal class frequency (constant-marginal null).

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any measurement_validity prerequisite fails (network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts; classifier not exactly reproducible from stored fields; PC power < 0.80; NC false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; E-certificate UNRESOLVED; egress rotation across sweeps; fewer than 3 T0 ambient intrinsic endpoints; fewer than 3 T0 ambient barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete; delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s; delta_ext actual delta < 3300 s).

2. E_UNEXPECTED_PATH: if the frozen E-certificate observes a second egress path with a distinct public IP at EXECUTE, complete the certificate, record the observation, take NO S-branch read, and return status COMPLETE with outcome INCONCLUSIVE (pre-registered halt: no unfrozen cross-vantage science is authorized).

3. S1_EXTENDED if READ_1800 (INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_1800 AND DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID_1800 AND STAT_SIG_1800) AND READ_3600 (INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_3600 AND DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID_3600 AND STAT_SIG_3600).
4. S1_HELD if READ_1800 holds but READ_3600 fails, reporting which 3600-evidence class fired among {intrinsic_break_3600, denylist_violation_3600, no_anchor_information_3600}.
5. S0_BREAK otherwise (measurement valid, READ_1800 fails), reporting which 1800-evidence class fired among {intrinsic_break_1800, denylist_violation_1800, no_anchor_information_1800}.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control failure and MUST NOT be reported as S0_BREAK/S1_HELD/S1_EXTENDED.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-FRESHNESS = EXPERIMENTAL retained (already the effective registry status via EXP-GRAPH-37992949248); no VALIDATED, no PRODUCT_CORE, no promotion. S1_EXTENDED/S1_HELD retain EXPERIMENTAL with an extended/quantified horizon ceiling; S0_BREAK retains EXPERIMENTAL with a bounded horizon. No event is emitted for C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-MEAS-VALID, C-DELTA-REPAIR or any other claim (scope_boundaries); Physics Q2/Q3 and guard calibration consume this packet through evidence_refs/handoff, not claim events.
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable to the frozen universe or oracle hosts; classifier not exactly reproducible from stored fields (any NC_CLASSIFIER_REPRODUCIBILITY mismatch); PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY_EXTENDED power < 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; E-certificate UNRESOLVED (echo disagreement with no majority); egress rotation across sweeps; fewer than 3 T0 ambient intrinsic endpoints; fewer than 3 T0 ambient barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete; delta_ref actual < 1500 s; delta_ext actual < 3300 s. These are attainability/measurement failures and MUST NOT be reported as science branches.
decision_rule.metric_definition: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in mutual information I(B_T0; B_delta) in nats over the binary barrier indicator (B = 1 iff ambient_class in barrier_set), with a B_EXCHANGE global endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations) and an endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [LO,HI] (10000 resamples; cluster = registrable_domain: URL host with one leading 'www.' stripped and the final two dot-separated labels retained).

primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT: DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta) = |{T0 intrinsic, non-intrinsic at delta}| / |T0 intrinsic|. DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta) = |{T0 non-intrinsic, intrinsic at delta}| / |T0 non-intrinsic|. Both computed on the intrinsic set only.
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_1800: (n_t0_intrinsic >= 3) AND for every intrinsic class c in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} present at T0: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c at 1800] >= 0.80.
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_3600: (n_t0_intrinsic >= 3) AND for every intrinsic class c present at T0: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c at 3600] >= 0.80.
primary_decision_quantities.STAT_SIG_1800: STATIONARITY_SKILL(1800) >= 0.05 AND B_EXCHANGE permutation p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0.
primary_decision_quantities.STAT_SIG_3600: STATIONARITY_SKILL(3600) >= 0.05 AND B_EXCHANGE permutation p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0.

secondary_quantities.AMBIENT_RATE_ONSET_n / AMBIENT_RATE_RECO: Ambient RATE_LIMIT_429 appearances (T0 non-429 -> later rung 429) and clearances across the ladder. Non-gating diagnostics (the induced Q3 stays with EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597).
secondary_quantities.ANYBARRIER_FALSE_ACCEPT: Fraction of T0 barrier_set endpoints that are non-barrier at delta (cost of a naive pooled denylist that includes rate-limits). Reported, non-gating.
secondary_quantities.CLASS_PERSISTENCE: Per T0 ambient class, the fraction of endpoints with that class at T0 that have the identical class at each rung. Reported for all classes; gating only via the intrinsic classes above.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_HORIZON: Largest contiguous prefix of rungs {300, 900, 1800, 3600} over which DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID holds; 0 if invalid at the first rung; right-censored at 3600 s.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_SKILL: Log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the anchor intrinsic-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at delta_ref and delta_ext. Reported, non-gating.
secondary_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENCE: Pooled fraction of T0 intrinsic endpoints whose lag ambient class equals their T0 class. Reported.
secondary_quantities.MI_CLASS: Plug-in 6-class mutual information I(C_T0; C_delta). Reported.
secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_BY_RUNG: STATIONARITY_SKILL at each rung in {300, 900, 1800, 3600}, each with its own B_EXCHANGE p. Reported.
secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) restricted to the 52 non-stress endpoints, with its own permutation p. Pre-registered robustness replica.
secondary_quantities.n_t0_intrinsic / n_t0_barrier: Anchor counts for gating and power diagnostics.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing on both mandate halves. (1) Horizon: breaks the right-censoring at 1800 s that S1 (EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597, audit PASS) explicitly left open, with the 0-1800 prefix replicating S1 rung-for-rung (same estimator, thresholds, pool, classifier; fresh lane/code/seeds) so S1_HELD doubles as an independent-lane replication and S0_BREAK as bounded change evidence; any branch quantifies the re-probe interval the dead-end policy and the freshness-guard calibration currently assume. (2) Egress: certifies-or-blocks the single most blocking substrate dependency in the program (Physics second-egress mandate EXP-PHYSICS-38121193195 has failed 6+ pre-freeze DESIGN attempts): E_BLOCKED with exact receipts PARKs the vantage thread on a substrate blocker and stops the failing loop; the halt clause keeps a surprise second path from becoming unfrozen science. Alternatives rejected: pure 1800 replication (duplicate of S1, no new information); denser rungs (more cost, marginal info); re-running the parked localhost design (barred by the frozen stop rule).
falsifier: TWO-SIDED AND FROZEN; all science branches are reachable through the frozen metric and branch logic (verified by pre-freeze offline calibration on synthetic worlds with the exact extended statistic, thresholds and the clustered-bootstrap CI-lower clause; see prereg.md section 6). Frozen thresholds: delta_ref_s = 1800; delta_ext_s = 3600; intrinsic_persistence_min = 0.80; tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.20; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL_nats = 0.05; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_false_positive_max = 0.05; min_t0_intrinsic = 3; min_t0_barrier = 3; delta_ref_min_actual = 1500 s; delta_ext_min_actual = 3300 s. Definitions: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c at delta] = fraction of endpoints whose T0 ambient class equals intrinsic class c and whose delta ambient class is also c. INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_*/DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(*)/DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(*)/DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID_*/STAT_SIG_* per decision_rule. S1_EXTENDED iff READ_1800 AND READ_3600. S1_HELD iff READ_1800 AND NOT READ_3600. S0_BREAK iff the measurement is valid AND NOT READ_1800, with the positive-evidence class reported among (a) INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT_1800 false (a durable intrinsic barrier changed class by 1800), (b) DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID_1800 false (a denylisted endpoint recovered, or a clean endpoint newly and durably blocked), (c) STAT_SIG_1800 false (anchor->lag barrier information no better than B_EXCHANGE). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control failure and MUST NOT be used for a science branch. Pre-freeze synthetic calibration (exact extended rule, PERM=500/BOOT=1000 documented approximation of frozen 10000): S1 selected in 294/300 planted-stationary replications at rho=0.98 and 277/300 at rho=0.92; S0 selected in 300/300 intrinsic-early-break and 300/300 exchangeable replications; S1_HELD selected in 300/300 late-break replications (break only at 3600); full STAT_SIG false-positive on exchangeable 0/300 (<= 0.05). Both directions, and the HELD middle, are arithmetically reachable.

evidence_refs: prereg.md:section 6 (calibration table: PC98 294/300 S1, PC92 277/300, NC 0/300 S1, BREAK_EARLY 300/300 S0, BREAK_LATE 300/300 HELD)
baseline_identifiability.reason: The four nulls are non-degenerate and mutually distinguishable on the frozen pool because S1 proved the pool mixes clean and barrier endpoints (6/57 intrinsic at anchor) so both barrier-indicator classes occur in every held-out computation. The DESIGN-local calibration applied the EXACT extended rule (including the clustered-bootstrap CI-lower clause and intrinsic-set-only denylist at both 1800 and 3600): history/anchor information exceeds the nulls in planted-stationary worlds (S1 294/300 at rho=0.98, 277/300 at rho=0.92) and does not in exchangeable/break worlds (S0 300/300, HELD 300/300 on late-break). No baseline sits at the ceiling in the S1 regime and none is unreachable in the S0 regime; B_CONSTANT_USABLE is a strict floor (predicts non-barrier everywhere) that a valid denylist must beat descriptively via DENYLIST_SKILL.

evidence_refs: prereg.md:section 7 (attainability: 3/3 echo agreement, 7/7 oracle groups live, 4/12 subset 403s)
control_sensitivity.reason: Two disjoint offline synthetic controls bracket the estimator (PC power 294/300 = 0.98 >= 0.80; NC false-positive 0/300 <= 0.05). Two live oracle groups validate the real code path in both directions (PC_ORACLE_BARRIER must classify deterministic 429/transport/403-plain; NC_CLEAN_ORACLE must classify 200/uuid/example as CLEAN); DESIGN-local probe confirmed all 7 oracle groups respond live (429s return HTTP 429, no-such-host DNS-fails, httpbin 403 returns HTTP 403, cleans return 200). NC_CLASSIFIER_REPRODUCIBILITY gives AUDIT exact recomputation from stored fields (status/headers/first-262144-bytes/error-string) with a 0-mismatch gate. Egress sensitivity is by construction: the certificate is a census (path enumeration + >=2 echo agreement); disagreement yields UNRESOLVED (INVALID), not a false provision; rotation across sweeps yields INVALID, not silent science.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All live branches are arithmetically reachable. S1_EXTENDED reachable: planted-stationary worlds select it in 294/300 (rho=0.98) replications and the live census proves endpoint-constant intrinsic barriers exist (S1 anchor 6/57; DESIGN probe 4 403s in a 12-endpoint subset). S1_HELD reachable: late-break worlds select it 300/300 (break only at 3600 gives FA up to 1.0 among small-n intrinsic sets, exceeding tau_FA=0.20). S0_BREAK reachable: early-break and exchangeable worlds select it 300/300 (one recovery among n_t0_intrinsic=3 gives FA=0.333 > 0.20; exchangeable gives STAT_SIG false). MEASUREMENT_INVALID reachable only via prerequisite/control failure (echo disagreement, rotation, unmet anchor floors, oracle failure), never via a science outcome. E_UNEXPECTED_PATH is a pre-registered halt contingency, not a science branch; E_PROVISIONED is deliberately NOT a live science branch (structurally unreachable per probe: single NIC/route, no proxy, no global IPv6) so no frozen branch depends on it.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No pre-existing mutable local fixture, task bank, dataset or code file is an interpretation dependency. Every interpretation-determining constant (frozen 57-endpoint universe written literally; challenge-marker regex and full intrinsic classifier written literally; 262144-byte search window; extended sweep protocol; strata; thresholds; seeds 38900926593/38900926594; branch precedence; egress-certificate procedure) is embedded verbatim in spec.json and prereg.md, which the deterministic freezer hashes directly. The collection/analysis code does not exist at freeze and is authored at EXECUTE strictly as a literal realization of those frozen constants (stdlib only; must not import research/runtime lane modules); its hash is recorded in provenance.json for AUDIT. Remote Web responses cannot be frozen; their target identifiers and sampling protocol are frozen in spec/prereg instead. The DESIGN-local probe/calibration scripts and /tmp outputs were deleted before freeze and are deliberately NOT interpretation dependencies (EXECUTE re-derives every quantity and floor from its own raw data).

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Pre-freeze probes established: (a) live network reaches the frozen universe (12/12 subset endpoints returned classifiable responses); (b) all 7 oracle hosts respond (429/403/DNS-fail/200 groups live); (c) the classifier's 403 arm is exercisable in this environment (4/12 subset returned HTTP 403; S1 anchor showed 5 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE + 1 TRANSPORT_ERROR); (d) echo/ASN services reachable (3/3 echo agreement on one IP; ip-api geo observed); (e) single-path structure confirmed (one NIC/default route, no proxy env, no global IPv6) so the E-certificate's BLOCKED branch is the reachable one. EXECUTE must re-verify network, oracles, anchor floors (n_t0_intrinsic>=3, n_t0_barrier>=3), echo agreement and actual-delta floors before any S-branch read; failure yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

treatment_liveness.reason: NOT_APPLICABLE: this substrate experiment contains no treatment/intervention arms. All observations are ambient single-GET probes (fresh-jar-equivalent, no cookies, no retries); the anchor-built denylist is a predictor evaluated against later rungs, not an executed intervention. There is therefore no treatment arm that could be structurally incapable of becoming EXECUTABLE. (The adaptive scheduler arms of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 and the induced burst probe of EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597 are deliberately not carried forward; see scope_boundaries.)

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BARRIER_note: barrier_set = {RATE_LIMIT_429, BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR}; ordinary_unavailability_set = {UNAVAILABLE_403, OTHER_NONBARRIER}; intrinsic_classes = {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR}.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP 403 AND (response header cf-mitigated == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE within the first 262144 body bytes).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CHALLENGE_RE_LITERAL: (?i)(just a moment|cf-browser-verification|cf[-_]chl[-_]|challenge-platform|cf-challenge|cdn-cgi/challenge|attention required|checking your browser|enable javascript and cookies|verify you are human|please complete the security check|g-recaptcha|hcaptcha|recaptcha|cf-turnstile|<title>\s*just a moment)
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status 2xx (200-299) AND body does not match CHALLENGE_RE within the first 262144 body bytes.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.ONSET_event: Previous rung ambient class CLEAN and current rung ambient class in barrier_set (reported diagnostic).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error) OR a 2xx carrying a challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused/reset, TLS failure, timeout). One attempt per observation, no retries.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.inherited_verbatim_from: codex/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597/prereg.md section 2 (itself verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068); reproduced literally here rather than read from another packet at run time.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single response's stored fields only (status, headers, first 262144 body bytes, transport error string); conditioning on the anchor state is not label leakage.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.severity_rank: TRANSPORT_ERROR 5 > RATE_LIMIT_429 4 > BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE 3 > UNAVAILABLE_403 2 > OTHER_NONBARRIER 1 > CLEAN 0 (diagnostic only; not used in gating)

frozen_universe.note: EXECUTE may not substitute, add, or drop endpoints. No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes.
frozen_universe.source: verbatim candidate_universe.endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068, via EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597; reproduced literally here

hypothesis.E_BLOCKED: The runner environment exposes a single egress path: one default route/interface, no proxy env, no global IPv6, and >=2 independent echo services agree on one public IP. The certificate returns E_BLOCKED with exact receipts (pre-freeze probe: single IP 135.119.238.192 across httpbin/ipify/ifconfig; no proxy; single NIC; link-local-only IPv6). Tor/VPN/WARP overlay paths are excluded a priori (prereg section 3.3) as construct confounds, not attempted as provision.
hypothesis.E_PROVISIONED: A second egress path yields a distinct public IP on >=2 echo observations. Structurally unreachable per pre-freeze probe; deliberately NOT a live science branch (unexpected observation triggers the E_UNEXPECTED_PATH halt, not unfrozen science).
hypothesis.H0_break: The intrinsic access-barrier state is NOT stationary through delta_ref on this pool/vantage/window: S0_BREAK (READ_1800 fails). The static denylist is not amortizable through 1800 s here; the dead-end policy must re-observe before relying on a cached per-endpoint decision. Bounded to this pool, one vantage, one window; does not close the C-FRESHNESS domain.
hypothesis.H1_extended: On this frozen pool/vantage the intrinsic access-barrier state is stationary through the extension: S1_EXTENDED (READY_1800 and READ_3600). A static intrinsic denylist measured at one window remains valid for at least 3600 s; the product dead-end policy may use the measured DENYLIST_HORIZON (>=3600 s, right-censored) as a quantified re-probe interval and the freshness-guard calibration consumes the horizon.
hypothesis.H1_held: Stationarity holds through delta_ref but breaks by delta_ext: S1_HELD (READ_1800, NOT READ_3600). Replicates S1 on the 0-1800 prefix (independent lane/code/seeds) and bounds the true horizon in (1800, 3600] with the breaking evidence class reported.
hypothesis.H_null: B_EXCHANGE: the lag barrier indicator is independent of the anchor barrier indicator beyond its marginal (exchangeable endpoints), so STATIONARITY_SKILL ~ 0 and an anchor-built denylist is no better than the no-denylist constant prior. Calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power and a false-positive bound (positive_control / null_control).
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1_extended/H1_held/H0_break are bounded programs on the C-FRESHNESS next_gate axis (endpoint drift with false-accept measurement): they quantify the validity horizon of an anchor-built intrinsic denylist with FA/FR bounds. H0/H1_held bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool, one vantage and one window. No branch advances C-FRESHNESS above EXPERIMENTAL.

measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is non-outcome-bearing and DESIGN-local: (i) environment path enumeration (interfaces/routes/proxy/IPv6) plus 3-service echo agreement and ASN-service reachability; (ii) a 12-endpoint fixed-subset reachability census with tentative classes and body sizes (no anchor/denylist/persistence/skill computation); (iii) 7-host oracle liveness; (iv) offline estimator/PC/NC calibration and branch-reachability runs on synthetic worlds implementing the EXACT extended rule including the clustered-bootstrap CI-lower clause (script cal_design_local.py sha256 fa3f87b1f9b6d97077f01af39c9150c01310633f129c34703685e4aebfd9e8b6, probe probe_design_local.py sha256 d8d676d0a22b89d66fa715bae7d4f668cfa3e317f03deef2175bb32a6bf1bf44; both deleted before freeze). These establish attainability, calibration and branch reachability only. EXECUTE re-verifies every floor and control from its own data; the probe scripts/outputs are DESIGN-local (/tmp) and are NOT interpretation dependencies.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY_EXTENDED power must be >= 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive must be <= 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications must be correct on every host; NC_CLASSIFIER_REPRODUCIBILITY must show 0 mismatches; E-certificate echo agreement and per-sweep egress stability must hold. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a science branch.
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Detection power at the observed T0 intrinsic counts is REPORTED (POWER_AT_RHO98, POWER_AT_RHO92 from the frozen calibration); it is not a gate. No branch depends on a non-significant negative being read as a break: S0_BREAK requires one of the three enumerated positive 1800-evidence classes.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Live network must reach the frozen universe and both oracle host groups. At T0 the number of ambient intrinsic endpoints must be >= 3 and ambient barrier endpoints >= 3; anchor and delta_ref sweeps must complete with actual deltas >= 1500 s; delta_ext sweep actual >= 3300 s; egress IP stable across sweeps. Any shortfall => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability failure).
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client (Python 3.12 standard library ONLY; no third-party packages; no lane-module imports), one frozen User-Agent, one network egress vantage, one continuous ~80-minute collection window. The source-vantage axis is NOT varied (E_BLOCKED expected) and is a declared scope boundary; a surprise second path triggers the halt clause, not improvised science. Challenge-marker detection reads stored response bytes (first 262144) with the frozen regex; any JavaScript-only challenge invisible to stdlib bytes is a declared scope boundary shared with S1 (Intel representation-probe dependency discharged in prereg section 10, not re-tested here).
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to, or dropped. Per-sweep probe order is a fresh seeded permutation (seed 38900926593, NOT S1's seed). No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes. Sweeps advance on a frozen wait schedule sharing no state between endpoints except the clock.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: The anchor T0 and all rungs are independent observations of the SAME endpoints; there is no train/test split. All primary metrics are closed-form functions of the per-endpoint class sequence. Sampling order within a sweep is a frozen seeded permutation and does not depend on outcomes.
measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after, location, content-type), the first 262144 body bytes, full body byte length, full-body SHA-256, elapsed ms, transport error string, sweep/endpoint ids and the sweep's egress IP. HTTP error statuses (429/403/404/500) MUST be captured as responses (catch HTTPError and read code+body), never as transport failures - a DESIGN-probe trap documented in prereg section 2. Classification is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields, so AUDIT recomputes every class exactly (NC_CLASSIFIER_REPRODUCIBILITY).
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation null: 10000 GLOBAL uniform shuffles of the lag barrier indicator across all 57 endpoints (seed 38900926593). Endpoint-clustered bootstrap: cluster = registrable_domain; 10000 resamples (seed 38900926593); percentile 95% CIs. NC synthetic uses seed 38900926594. No Gaussian-jitter or other mislabeled uncertainty.

C_EGRESS_STABILITY.description: Egress IP recorded at every sweep (one echo request per sweep). If the observed public IP differs across sweeps (EGRESS_ROTATION), the horizon read is confounded by an uncontrolled vantage shift: complete the ladder, preserve the raw, and return MEASUREMENT_INVALID with reason EGRESS_ROTATION (fail-closed; the rotated ladder is preserved evidence for a future mandate, not a science read).
C_EGRESS_STABILITY.pass_condition: Identical public IP string on all 5 sweeps; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.description: Validity control for self-induction, NOT a statistical null: ambient barrier prevalence trend across the ladder rungs over all 57 endpoints, plus STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS on the 52 non-stress endpoints. A trend whose clustered CI excludes 0, or a large full-vs-no-stress gap, is disclosed as a self-induction caveat.
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.endpoints: all 57 frozen endpoints (primary) and the 52 outside stratum_stress (replica)
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.pass_condition: No hard pass/fail; reported transparently in result.json.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control: hosts that must classify CLEAN, confirming the classifier does not fire on clean responses and the 200-arm of the retention pipeline works.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

NC_CLASSIFIER_REPRODUCIBILITY.description: AUDIT exactly recomputes every stored observation's class from its stored fields (status, headers, first-262144-bytes, error string) with the frozen regex. Any mismatch is an instrument defect, not science.

NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: anchor and lag states drawn independently from the same marginal (S1 pilot marginal: 46 CLEAN, 5 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, 1 TRANSPORT_ERROR, 5 OTHER_NONBARRIER); the SAME estimator, permutation test and exact extended branch rule are applied.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with full STAT_SIG (either delta) <= 0.05. DESIGN-local calibration: 0/300 (0.0). EXECUTE re-verifies from its own run.

established_preserved: Reuse-based signal-driven localized repair is functionally sound on the localhost ThreadingHTTPServer substrate/carrier (108/108 valid trials, repair_success 1.0, contamination 0/432) - substrate-local fact, not transferred.
Shipped-counter premise exact (612/648/684; http 216/180/216 vs 288/324); treatment identity intact (BulkArm single replace, V-REG-EQUIV true).
Priced pattern at audited ceiling: 10 cells WIN / 2 MARGINAL (P1-L2 R=0.9893 CIBF upper 1.00441; P3-L2 R=0.9902 upper 1.00442) / 0 LOSS; aggregate INCONCLUSIVE (marginal straddle).
Mandate stop trigger fired: second consecutive marginal straddle at N=36 PARKs the thread - no re-admission, no permanent drop, no promotion, no third N increase on this substrate.
rejected_preserved: Robust latency LOSS / bounded permanent drop on the localhost substrate (0 LOSS cells).
Uncorrected 95% CIs as gating moves (only Bonferroni CIBF gates).
BulkArm treatment-identity / registry-equivalence failure; cold-nominal drift / reuse-count anomaly.
unknown_preserved: Whether the two MARGINAL cells resolve on a higher-resolution substrate or symmetric S-ARG policy - UNFUNDED, not pursued here (this design contains no localhost timing work).
Separability of the ~0.05ms residual from the ~0.078ms S-ARG operand asymmetry.
Transfer of any latency ratio/median/N* beyond the pinned localhost vantage.
B3 model-call/token economics (structural zeros; not measured here).

C_EGRESS_CERTIFICATE.description: Frozen certificate procedure executed FIRST at EXECUTE (cheap, ~15 requests, no ladder commitment): enumerate local paths (interfaces, routes, proxy env vars, global IPv6 route+test) and observe public egress IP via >=3 independent echo services (+ best-effort ASN via ip-api). Agreement of >=2 echo services on one IP with a single enumerated path yields E_BLOCKED with exact receipts. Echo disagreement with no majority yields E-state UNRESOLVED. A distinct second-path public IP (unexpected per probe) triggers the E_UNEXPECTED_PATH halt, not science.

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status: httpbin 429 and httpbingo 429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; no-such-host.invalid must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR; httpbin 403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving 403-as-plain is not read as a challenge block). Tests the live collection+classifier path including HTTP-error-body capture.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request classified into its expected class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY_EXTENDED.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator and extended branch logic recover a known stationary endpoint population at n=57 across both deltas; it does not assert that any real endpoint is stationary.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY_EXTENDED.description: Offline planted-stationary generator on the S1 pilot marginal (46 CLEAN, 5 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, 1 TRANSPORT_ERROR, 5 OTHER_NONBARRIER): the 3600-lag class equals the anchor class with probability rho, else redrawn from the marginal; the SAME plug-in binary-barrier MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation test, the same per-class persistence rule at both deltas, and the exact extended branch logic (S1_EXTENDED/S1_HELD/S0_BREAK) are applied.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY_EXTENDED.power_requirement: Fraction of replications selecting S1_EXTENDED must be >= 0.80 at rho=0.98 (DESIGN-local calibration: 294/300 = 0.98; at rho=0.92: 277/300 = 0.923, reported). EXECUTE re-verifies from its own run.

product_consequence_negative: If S0_BREAK: the endpoint intrinsic access decision is not amortizable through delta_ref on this pool/vantage/window - the dead-end policy must re-observe before relying on a cached per-endpoint decision, no long static denylist horizon is licensed, and the freshness-guard calibration consumes a bounded (sub-1800 s) horizon with the breaking evidence class stated. If E_BLOCKED: Physics second-vantage thread PARKs on the certified substrate blocker (exact receipts) instead of another failing pre-freeze attempt. Either way bounded to this frozen pool, one vantage, one window; bounds (does not close) the C-FRESHNESS domain. No code promotion (Runtime lane; experiment-local code only; granted-scope modules untouched).
product_consequence_positive: If S1_EXTENDED: a static intrinsic-access denylist built at one window remains valid through at least 3600 s (right-censored) on this pool - the dead-end policy adopts the measured DENYLIST_HORIZON as a quantified re-probe interval and the freshness-guard calibration (first-party persistence economics) consumes the horizon. If S1_HELD: S1 replicates on an independent lane/code/seed and the horizon is bounded in (1800, 3600] with the breaking class stated. If E_BLOCKED with exact receipts: the shared substrate delivers the one measurement Physics Q2/Q3 needs to proceed-or-park (a certified single-egress blocker). No promotion (Runtime lane; no product code changes).
question: (Q-E, substrate provision-or-block) From this runner environment, can Runtime provision a minimal second independent egress (a distinct egress path with a distinct observed public IP) for the frozen barrier/denylist substrate - or else certify with exact receipts that no second egress exists (single egress identity, enumerated paths, excluded alternatives with reasons) - thereby unblocking-or-parking Physics Q2/Q3, which require the same window ladder at a second vantage? (Q-H, validity horizon) Keyed to the frozen intrinsic classifier (verbatim, incl. the 262144-byte challenge-marker search window) and the frozen window ladder (prefix rungs 0/300/900/1800) plus one pre-registered extension rung (3600), what is the measured validity horizon of an anchor-built intrinsic denylist: per-intrinsic-class CLASS_PERSISTENCE and DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT / DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT with endpoint-clustered bounds - does validity hold through the S1 right-censoring limit (1800 s replication prefix) and through 3600 s (extension)?
scope_boundaries: Credential-free public HTTP GET only; no authentication, JavaScript, DOM, SPA, GraphQL or WebSocket.

One stdlib-HTTP client, one frozen User-Agent, one network egress vantage (E_BLOCKED expected), one continuous ~80-minute collection window; the source-vantage axis is NOT varied by this design (a surprise second path halts, it does not improvise cross-vantage science).
The frozen 57-endpoint universe is used unchanged and is NOT extended; no post-outcome substitution or dropping.
No LLM calls, no browser, no credentials, no third-party packages, no lane-module imports.

The induced-transience burst probe of EXP-PHYSICS-38074818597 is deliberately NOT carried forward (S1 settled class-conditional rate transience: RATE_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE 2 s); ambient 429 onset/recovery counts are kept as non-gating diagnostics only.
The horizon/denylist object is tested only through the frozen intrinsic classifier and the frozen ambient ladder; the horizon is censored at delta_ext = 3600 s.
This design contains no localhost timing work, no S-ARG policy variation and no N increase: the parked 12-cell delta-repair thread (frozen stop rule) is untouched.
No C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-MEAS-VALID, C-DELTA-REPAIR or other claim events are emitted; Physics Q2/Q3 and guard calibration consume this packet through evidence_refs and handoff, not claim updates.

policies: POLICY_STATIC_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC (conditional on S1_EXTENDED/S1_HELD, bounded to measured horizon)

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for STATIONARITY_SKILL and the intrinsic denylist at both deltas.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent candidates from accepted evidence; reported as a diagnostic subgroup, NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_stress.definition: Fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable set from accepted evidence; NO burst probe is executed in this design (probe dropped, see scope_boundaries); the 5 endpoints are ordinary ambient members and the 52-outside replica is computed over the same 52 as S1.

sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY endpoint: NO cookie processor installed (fresh-jar-equivalent by construction), then exactly ONE HTTP GET; store raw fields; ambient_class = frozen classifier output. Endpoints probed sequentially in a per-sweep frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38900926593) with inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s. The PRIMARY state for all stationarity/denylist metrics is ambient_class.
sweep_protocol.anchor: Sweep 0 (T0). The anchor-built denylist = the set of T0 intrinsic endpoints.
sweep_protocol.delta_ext_actual_rule: The delta_ext sweep's actual elapsed delta (anchor start to ext-sweep start, per-endpoint actuals recorded) must be >= 3300 s or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
sweep_protocol.delta_ref_actual_rule: The delta_ref sweep's actual elapsed delta must be >= 1500 s or the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
sweep_protocol.egress_ip_per_sweep: One echo request (https://httpbin.org/ip) per sweep; recorded. Any cross-sweep IP change (EGRESS_ROTATION) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (raw preserved).

request_policy.http_error_capture: REQUIRED: HTTP error statuses (429/403/404/500) MUST be captured as responses by catching HTTPError and reading code+body+headers; they MUST NOT be recorded as TRANSPORT_ERROR (DESIGN-probe trap: bare urlopen raises on 4xx/5xx).
request_policy.note: No retry, so a DNS/connect/TLS/timeout failure is directly TRANSPORT_ERROR.

sweep_protocol.rung_labeling: Analysis labels each sweep by its NOMINAL rung; per-endpoint actual elapsed deltas are recorded and reported.
